CustomField.description: The property this meter serves. FSD 5.10.4 requires the register to be maintained by property and space. Lookup rather than master detail so that a meter survives a property record being replaced, and so the object can keep its own Private OWD.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The property this meter is installed at. Always set this, even when the meter serves the whole building rather than one suite.
CustomField.label: Property
